premise: The cube should be measured by capabilities earned, not by raw record count.

capabilities.name: case_integrity
capabilities.dream: A user can trust that an individual record distinguishes source, claim, interpretation, uncertainty, and current status.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Second-review records with claim-by-claim source locators and explicit unknowns.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not summarize famous cases from memory and call them records.
capabilities.current_state: partially earned in promoted records; second-review backlog remains.

capabilities.name: denominator_visibility
capabilities.dream: A user can see what was attempted, unpublished, abandoned, registered, corrected, or selectively reported, not merely what succeeded.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Audit-pair records, registries, abandoned/negative sources, and field-specific denominator rails.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not infer missingness from vibes; use paired surfaces where possible.
capabilities.current_state: begun via INF and MET records; many domains lack denominator rails.

capabilities.name: status_history_memory
capabilities.dream: A claim has a life history instead of a verdict: proposed, canonized, challenged, narrowed, reversed, revived, or practice-persistent.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Status-history arrays with dates, sources, and rollback triggers.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not freeze current consensus as final truth.
capabilities.current_state: conceptually present; schemas need stronger shared status-history structures.

capabilities.name: practice_lag_visibility
capabilities.dream: The cube can show when evidence changed but clinical, engineering, classroom, policy, software, or public practice did not.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Guideline, coverage, utilization, textbook, product, or policy timelines linked to evidence-shift records.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not treat publication as de-adoption.
capabilities.current_state: opened in rev0013; needs adoption curves and child records.

capabilities.name: warning_governance_memory
capabilities.dream: The cube can answer what warnings existed, who heard them, what authority they had, and why they failed or succeeded.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Warning source, recipient, action threshold, proof burden, escalation path, and stop authority fields.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not convert hindsight into obviousness.
capabilities.current_state: begun in rev0006 and rev0007; near-miss success cases needed.

capabilities.name: correction_surface_inventory
capabilities.dream: The cube can map the infrastructures that make failure visible: registries, inquiry boards, accident reports, reporting channels, databases, guidelines, retraction systems, and post-publication review.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: INF records with class, capture model, output, limitations, blind spots, and downstream use.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not treat infrastructure existence as effectiveness proof.
capabilities.current_state: strongest current foundation; needs quality/completeness comparisons.

capabilities.name: cross_domain_pattern_discovery
capabilities.dream: A pattern can be queried across medicine, engineering, software, science, policy, and genealogy without flattening domain differences.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Pattern records with supporting cases, negative controls, scope limits, counterexamples, and falsification/rollback triggers.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not promote memorable analogy into mature synthesis.

capabilities.name: genealogy_of_correction
capabilities.dream: The cube can explain how claims and corrections travel: who transmitted, resisted, translated, canonized, neglected, or revived them.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Influence edges with evidence class, source, uncertainty, and relation type.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not treat co-presence, citation, or advisor relation as proof of deep influence.

capabilities.name: pedagogical_failure_literacy
capabilities.dream: The cube can teach students, engineers, policymakers, journalists, and AI systems how to reason with uncertainty, failed attempts, correction, and humility.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Learning modules downstream of source-backed records, with examples and counterexamples.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not teach from unsourced anecdotes or morality tales.
capabilities.current_state: not yet built; narrative summaries are only precursors.

capabilities.name: machine_usable_epistemic_training
capabilities.dream: Models trained or queried against the cube learn the texture of epistemic motion: error, uncertainty, disagreement, correction, scope, and revival.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Structured records with stable IDs, claim links, status histories, source permanence, and explicit non-goals.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not produce opaque prose-only archives that cannot be audited or parsed.
capabilities.current_state: early structure exists; graph/query layer absent.

capabilities.name: public_trust_through_honesty
capabilities.dream: The public account of science and engineering becomes more trustworthy because it includes correction, not because it hides failure.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Ethical, non-shaming records that show how systems learn and where they fail to learn.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not weaponize failure to discredit whole fields.

capabilities.name: funding_and_research_triage
capabilities.dream: Funders and researchers can identify dead ends, under-replicated claims, missing denominator rails, and high-value review targets.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Query primitives, source-density maps, claim fragility surfaces, and backlog severity scoring.
capabilities.anti_cheat: Do not score fragility without transparent criteria and review.
capabilities.current_state: not yet earned; followthrough queue is a seed.

revision_instruction: When adding future records, state which earned capability the work advances or what weakness it tests.
